questions: Q1: Which answers does the approval question offer: yes / no / stop (recommended), yes / no, or yes / stop?
Q2: Who sets the id and text of the approval question: the engine (recommended), or the YAML author as for interrupt nodes?
Q3: When a loop enters the same approval node again, is the question asked again on every entry (recommended), or is the earlier answer reused?
Q4: Does T1 include factory/spec/workflow.schema.json and the auto-answer code in factory/host/cli-matrix.ts and factory/app/data.ts (recommended), or only the engine and the loader?
Q5: When approval is set on a node that is not kind: script, does the load fail with an error naming the node id (recommended), or is the field ignored?
Q6: Which answer do the auto-answer helpers give to an approval question: no (recommended), stop, or yes?
Q7: When the approval answer is stop, does the run end with status stopped as the budget stop does (recommended), or with another status?

feature.title: Approval gate before a script operation
feature.goal: A script node marked approval: required waits for the user before its operation runs.
criteria: FAC1: A script node with approval: required asks the user before its operation runs.

tasks.title: Approval gate in the engine and the loader
criteria: AC1: The operation of an approval node does not run before the user answers.

- Feature: Approval gate before a script operation
